system.description:
A Cainite using Madman's Quill weaves a contagious madness into a work of art or a manuscript — the swirls of a pen or brush, the lines of a carving, the notes of a tune, or the tiles of a mosaic — encoding the Malkavian's own lunacy for transmission to any kine or Cainite who studies it. The victim is usually only dimly aware that the art or document is tied to his madness; gnawing obsessions and paranoia are common effects, chosen so as to preserve the vehicle from destruction. Only prolonged, informed observation uncovers the arcane madness woven into the item.

System: The Malkavian chooses a single active Dementation power he knows (any except Eyes of Chaos), spends one Blood Trait, and rolls Manipulation + Crafts, Linguistics, or Music (depending on the medium) against a difficulty of 5 plus the encoded power's level; the process takes a number of hours equal to the power's level. Successes determine the duration the item remains infectious: 1 success/one week, 2/one month, 3/three months, 4/one year, 5+/indefinite. Anyone (other than the creator) who observes the item for two minutes or more during that time is affected by the encoded power as if the Malkavian herself had used it, and also gains a derangement (Storyteller's choice, guided by the number of successes; obsession and paranoia are common) focused on the item. Both derangement and encoded power end if the item is destroyed or the duration lapses. A character who resists the encoded Dementation outright may notice something is wrong with a Perception + Occult roll (difficulty 8). Madman's Quill need only be learned once to encode any qualifying Dementation power and costs 15 experience to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
